title: feat(spec)!: object-metric drillDown and compareTo take the shape the tile reads; object-grid columns exits its hold (#21464, stage 5)
body:
Part of #21464
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What this does

Stage 5 of the `ComponentPropsMap` `z.unknown()` close-out: the S-metric remainder and the exit of the `object-grid` `columns` hold, per the claim `5975220557`, the seat's S-metric answer `5972917488` (§1 `drillDown`: B; §2 `compareTo`: B), the staging answer `5963787404`, the holds' carrier answer `5969669440`, stage 4's landing `5973565761` and `domain:devx`'s pointer `5974144504`. Three narrowings, one ADR-0087 D3 entry each. Read points are at the `.objectui-sha` pin `ab1879721595` (this repo's pin), under `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/` or `packages/plugin-grid/src/` unless named.

| member | was | now | read point at `ab1879721595` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `object-metric` `compareTo` | `z.unknown()` | strict `{ kind }` (module-private `ObjectMetricCompareToSchema`): `kind` is `DashboardWidgetSchema.shape.compareTo`'s own `kind` by reference; `dimension` refused by name with the prescription | `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx:522-523` (`shiftFilterByCompareTo`) and `:675` (`compareToTrendLabelKey`); both dispatch on `kind === 'previousYear'` alone (objectui `core/src/utils/compare-to.ts:104`, `:128`), and the file's header records `dimension` as never read on this path (`:28-33`) |
| `object-metric` `drillDown` | `z.unknown()` | strict `{ enabled?, title?, target?, columns?, maxRows?, report? }` (module-private `ObjectMetricDrillDownSchema`): the first five are `ChartDrillDownSchema.shape`'s members by reference; `filter` and `mode` refused by name with objectui's prescriptions; `report` HELD at `z.unknown()` | `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx:696` (`isDrillEnabled`), `:708` (`resolveDrillTitle` against an empty click event), `:732-744` (the shared `DrillDownDrawer`: `target`, `columns`, `maxRows`, `report`); objectui's own `ObjectMetricDrillDownConfig` refuses `filter` and `mode` by name (`types/src/data-display.ts:2628`) |
| `object-grid` `columns` | `z.array(z.unknown())`, held at stage 2 | `ListViewSchema.shape.columns` by reference (the reference stage 2 held it from) | `ObjectGrid.tsx:819` (`normalizeColumns`), `:3367` / `:3451` (the draw path keeps only an entry with a string `field`, reading `ListColumn`'s own members); `groupValueFormatter` (`:2979`) now reads the column's `type` alone, typed as `ListColumn` (`:3004-3007`), and the labels from `objectDefField?.options` only (`:3010`) |

`enabled` and `title` keep the chart drill-down's defs (`_zod.def` identity, pinned) with describes of their own, because the chart's speak of a clicked segment and its `${event.*}` tokens, and a metric tile has no click context. No new member carries a default or a transform, so `ObjectMetricPropsParsed` still differs from the authored state on `filter` alone; a parsed grid column's `prefix.type` carries the list view's `'text'` default, as stage 2 originally recorded. No new export: both new schemas are module-private.

## The holds, re-read at `ab1879721595`

- **`object-grid` `columns`: exit condition met.** Stage 2's records held the member on one read (`colOverride?.options || objectDefField?.options` at `89cad75d55`), and the writer test (`5966636964`) held it only if a renderer path at the pin reads `editable` or `options` off an authored column. objectui `b0bf413` (objectstack-ai/objectui#11544) retired the `options` read, and no read takes `editable` (or `reference`) off an authored column: the emitted columns are built key by key from `ListColumn` members (`:3676-3702`), and every object spread at `:4384`, `:4483`, `:4628`, `:4728` is of an EMITTED column. The three records that said the grid reads `columns[].options` are corrected: the docblock in `component.zod.ts`, the enumeration pin's held line (removed) and the list-family pin's header. One finding beside the exit, see Acceptance notes: the footer summary still reads four undeclared column keys.
- **`object-metric` `drillDown.report`: stays held**, as ruled. Its docblock is re-anchored: the drawer draws a dataset-bound report when `isDatasetBoundReport` holds (`DrillDownDrawer.tsx:92`, used at `:115`; objectui#11506, `8366acc`), and objectui#11517 (`9ed8d0f`) refuses the `{ name }` arm. Expressed in the house shape: the enumeration pin's walk reaches it as `object-metric drillDown.report`, a `staged('objectui-held', …)` ledger line, and the `object-metric` stage leaves `STAGES` (its four members are typed). No fork was needed.

## The census

A writer is a value written on the block: a page-component node (an object literal naming the type, a literal annotated or asserted with the block's type, a direct parse through the row), the block's React component with the member as a prop or inside an object-literal `schema`, or the argument of a local helper that mounts one, with positional helper parameters resolved at every call site. Values resolve through same-file constants. Instrument: a TypeScript-AST walk over every `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.js`, `.jsx`, `.mjs`, `.cjs`, `.json`, `.yaml`, `.md` and `.mdx` file (fenced code in documents parsed too). Each static value was parsed through the row at this branch's source, and the grid's refused set was cross-checked against `ListViewSchema.shape.columns` directly (identical).

| corpus | `compareTo` | `drillDown` | `object-grid` `columns` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| objectstack `6ec54f00ba` (`examples/`, `packages/` with `packages/apps/`, `content/`, `skills/`, `apps/`, `docs/`) | 0 | 0 | 5 · 5 static · 5 parse |
| objectui `ab1879721595` (whole tree, `git archive` of the pin) | 5 · 5 (3 distinct) · 4 parse · 1 refused | 26 · 25 static (13) · 23 parse · 2 refused · 1 not static | 362 · 353 static (147) · 312 parse · 41 refused · 9 not static |

**objectstack writers.** The showcase's two grids (`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/my-work.page.ts:65`, `command-center.page.ts:172`) and three test copies (`packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.test.ts:553`, `:577`, `packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts:3433`): all field-name strings, all parse, all drawn. `origin/main` moved four commits since the base (to `fea67065a3`); none touches `packages/spec`, and none adds a line naming `object-grid`, `object-metric`, `drillDown` or `compareTo`.

**objectui writers, under the writer test.** Every value is a test fixture or a run-time hand-off. Each refused value:

| refused value | where at the pin | drawn or probe |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `compareTo: { kind: 'previousYear', dimension: 'close_date' }` | `plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/ObjectMetricWidget.compareTo.test.tsx:109` | probe: "carries a dimension without letting it touch the query" |
| `drillDown: { enabled: true, filter: { stage: 'won' } }` and `{ enabled: true, mode: 'record' }` | `plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/ObjectMetricWidget.drillDownRefusal-9002.test.tsx:56`, `:58` | compile-time refusal probes (`@ts-expect-error`) |
| 17 columns keyed `accessorKey` / `header` | `columnDeclaredSpellingOnly` ×4, `columnSpellingDiagnosticRender` ×9, `ObjectGrid.malformedFilter-9050` ×3, `authoredColumnsFls-6799:409` | not drawn: `resolvesToDataColumn` needs `field`; the spelling diagnostic names them |
| 5 columns keyed `name` | `projectionFls-6898:206`, `authoredColumnsFls-6799:333`, `columnIdentity` ×3 | not drawn by that key: the draw path reads `field` (the identity fold reads `name` for the projection and field security only, `field` winning) |
| 14 columns carrying `editable: false` | `gridDependentValues-7165`, `lookupPickerKeys-7154` ×5, `relationalMetaCopySet-7166` ×4, `inlineEditExitMode` ×2, `inlineEditPersistence`, `inlineEditLookupRepro` | the column draws; no read takes `editable` off an authored column |
| 1 column carrying `reference` | `ObjectGrid.linkCellAnchor.test.tsx:252` | the column draws; relational metadata comes from the object field (`applyRelationalMeta`), and the test asserts the cell stays plain |
| 2 columns carrying `options` | `gridGroupingMembers-8071.test.tsx:293`, `:312` | probes: the tests assert the column `options` are NOT read |
| 1 column with no `field` | `serverGroupedSelectIdentity-11105.test.tsx:162` | not drawn (`resolvesToDataColumn`) |
| `columns: 5` | `types/src/__tests__/element-data-source-objectname-waiver-11117.test.ts:154` | a refusal probe through objectui's own mirror |

The not-static values: one `drillDown` `it.each` over two report probes (both parse: `report` is held open); for `columns`, the run-time hand-offs in `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:2487`, `plugin-designer/src/ObjectManager.tsx:116` and `FieldDesigner.tsx:188` (the designers' lists are `{ field, label, width }`), and six test lists built from `{ field, label[, type] }` entries, which parse by construction. Stage 2 counted 40 refused `columns` values with a different instrument; the 41st here, the `reference` column, was present at `89cad75d55` too.

## Changes

- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`: `ObjectMetricDrillDownSchema` and `ObjectMetricCompareToSchema` (module-private) with their docblocks and prescriptions; the two members; `columns` back to `ListViewSchema.shape.columns` with the exit docblock; the grid row and `ObjectGridPropsParsed` docblocks; imports of `ChartDrillDownSchema` (beside `ChartGroupBySchema`) and `DashboardWidgetSchema` (`dashboard.zod.ts` imports nothing that reaches `component.zod.ts`; the eager `gen:schema` build is green).
- `packages/spec/src/ui/component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts`: the `drillDown`, `compareTo` and `columns[]` lines leave the ledger; `drillDown.report` joins as `objectui-held`; the `object-metric` stage leaves `STAGES`, whose `objectui-held` text now names the drill report.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/component-metric-family-typed-members.pin.test.ts`: §1 seven new byte-identical parses (objectui's drill and comparison writers), §2 ten new refusals by `code` and path plus three prescription checks, §3 def identity for the five drill members and `kind`, and each shape's exact member set, §4 the two new D3 ids.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/component-list-family-typed-members.pin.test.ts`: the `columns` cases stage 2's fix round removed come back (§1 two parses and the `prefix` default, §2 nine union refusals including `options`, `reference` and a footer `precision` hint, §3 def identity), and the header no longer says the grid reads a column's `options`.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-object-metric-compare-to-typed.ts`, `18.ui-object-metric-drill-down-typed.ts`, `18.ui-object-grid-columns-typed.ts` (new) and `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`: three hand-written step-18 rationale fragments at orders 71, 72 and 73 (70, #21632's, is the last taken on `main`), and the semantic region regenerated by `gen:migration-registry`. No D2 conversion: nothing stored needs rewriting, since page-component `properties` is not parsed on the save or load path. No `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` row: the refused keys are nested in member shapes, not top-level row keys.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` (`gen:docs`) and `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/ui.md` (`gen:strictness-ledger`: `ui/` 194 → 196 sites, +2 strict).
- `.changeset/21464-component-props-metric-rest-and-grid-columns-typed.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, BREAKING banner, the `Clause-②` line, the FROM → TO table, the census, and the ADR-0087 marker registering the three ids.

## Measurements

All on the head `a10f94d7c4` (base `6ec54f00ba`; 11 files, +765 / −119, 884 changed lines, under the 5000 threshold). Heavy runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, and every exit code was written to a file before it was read.

- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`**: exit 0 — Test Files 609 passed (609); Tests 18095 passed, 1 todo.
- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`**: exit 0 — `check:test-typecheck: OK` (52 files / 246 errors / 135 signatures held, unmoved); `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` names all three pins.
- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` and `check:generated --fix`**: the build is green (the eager `gen:schema` pass included); `--fix` regenerated only what it proved stale (`gen:docs`, `gen:strictness-ledger`), and the derived `check:generated` then exits 0.

- **Ablation**, one leg per narrowing, on the committed tree (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode inside a script with its own `EXIT INT TERM` restore trap on absolute paths, HEAD-blob comparison, an empty hash read as failure). Each leg reverts one member to its former `z.unknown()` form and runs the three pins (175 tests):
  - `compareTo` → `z.unknown().optional()`: anchor x1 → x0, blob `b3bba43a35` → `4ef63a8559`. Red: 8 failed, 167 passed. The enumeration pin's §1 received exactly `[ "object-metric compareTo" ]` and its census-equals-ledger control read 92 against 91; the companion pin failed its four comparison refusals, the `dimension` prescription and the `kind` def identity.
  - `drillDown` → `z.unknown().optional()`: blob → `51d55b8e7b`. Red: 12 failed, 163 passed. §1 received `[ "object-metric drillDown" ]`, and its second half `[ "object-metric drillDown.report" ]` (a ledger line outliving its member); the companion pin failed its six drill refusals, the two prescriptions and both §3 cases.

- **Derived gates**: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) — 114 commands; `--ran` — "Run reconciliation — 114 derived, 114 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", exit 0, all 114 exit 0. ## Acceptance notes

- **objectui's grid footer still reads four column keys `ListColumn` does not declare.** `plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts:558-568` at the pin formats a column's summary with `(col as any).currency`, `.defaultCurrency`, `.precision` and `.scale` ahead of the field's (the same file reads `currencyConfig` and `max` off the field only, saying a column-level read "would be a second, undeclared spelling"). The read was there at `89cad75d55` too. No measured writer authors one on an `object-grid` column, so under the writer test it holds nothing, and a list view's columns (the same entry) already refuse all four; with this PR the grid row refuses them as well (pinned: the `precision` case in the list-family pin). Reported for the seat as an objectui finding, the shape objectstack-ai/objectui#11544 had.
- **The drill `report`'s contract may be cheaper than the hold suggests.** At the pin objectui types `DrillDownConfig.report` as this spec's own `ReportSchema` author input (`types/src/data-display.ts:23-24`, `:2592`, `SpecReportInput`), and the drawer applies the spec report's `runtimeFilter`. So the S-objectui-held step for `report` may reduce to the spec declaring the member by reference to `ReportSchema`. Not done here, as ruled; raised for the seat.
- **objectui's next `@objectstack/spec` bump:** its block schemas take these rows by reference (`ObjectMetricBlockSchema`, `ObjectGridBlockSchema`, through `propsBag`), but no objectui fixture that authors a refused value parses through them: the refused metric values mount the widget directly, and the refused grid columns mount `ObjectGrid` directly. objectui source does not import the narrowed `ObjectMetricProps` / `ObjectGridProps` types. Not built here: the Console Pin Gate builds objectui at the pin against `main`, and its filter does not list `packages/spec/src/**`.
- **`check-widening-tells --declaration no` exits 4 with seven T1 tells**, every one a key inside a former `z.unknown()` bag (the drill's six members, `compareTo.kind`), the shape the gate rules a true refusal; `--declaration yes` exits 0. The claim, this body and the changeset declare `yes (narrowing)`.
